observable_failure_step.description: Code generator scripts embedded row numbers into strings and merged variable/subscale columns without taxonomic separation.

root_cause_diagnosis: The generation agent and compilation scripts failed to maintain structural separation for taxonomic hierarchy in tables. By embedding row numbers into text and concatenating parent variables with subscales into single columns ('متغیر/سازه' or 'متغیرها'), the agent produced visually flattened tables lacking the required multi-column architecture.
prescribed_behavior: Strictly enforce a mandatory 3-column prefix layout for all relevant Chapter 4 tables (Descriptives, Reliability, Correlations). Specifically: Column 1 must be 'ردیف' (row number), Column 2 must be 'متغیر' (Parent Construct), and Column 3 must be 'مؤلفه' (Subscale). Never embed numbers into variable names. Update 'compile_gold_standard_chapter4.py' to expand table dimensions accordingly (e.g., Table 4-15 from 11 to 13 columns) to separate these entities.
